# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_settings_doc.py from inventree_mouser/core.py - do not edit by hand. -->

All settings are on the plugin's settings page in InvenTree (Admin Center → Plugins → Mouser Integration). Defaults are the safe choice unless noted.

## Mouser account

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Search API key | `SEARCH_API_KEY` | (blank) | My Mouser > APIs > Search API. Used to search Mouser and create parts. (Stored protected.) |
| Order API key | `ORDER_API_KEY` | (blank) | My Mouser > APIs > Order API (a different key). Used to read your orders and fill carts. (Stored protected.) |
| Mouser website | `MOUSER_SITE` | `www.mouser.com` | Your Mouser site, for links, e.g. au.mouser.com. |
| Country code | `COUNTRY_CODE` | (blank) | Two-letter country Mouser prices carts for, e.g. AU (Mouser needs one). Blank = worked out from Currency code, else InvenTree's default currency. |
| Currency code | `CURRENCY_CODE` | (blank) | Currency for carts, e.g. AUD. Blank = the country's currency. |

## Creating parts

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Download part images | `DOWNLOAD_IMAGES` | no | Put Mouser's picture on a part created from Mouser (when it has none) |
| New parts category | `NEW_PART_CATEGORY` | (blank) | Where the order import creates parts that weren't in InvenTree, to be moved to their own category. Blank = "Mouser Imports" is created the first time. |

## Order import

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Import Mouser orders daily | `ORDER_IMPORT` | no | Check Mouser once a day for new orders and make purchase orders from them. |
| Import orders placed from | `ORDER_IMPORT_START` | (blank) | DD-MM-YYYY, e.g. 24-10-2026. Orders placed before this date are never imported (so orders already entered by hand aren't doubled up). Required for the daily check. |
| Check at hour | `ORDER_IMPORT_HOUR` | `6` | Hour of the day (0-23, server time) the daily check runs at or after. |
| Look back (days) | `ORDER_LOOKBACK_DAYS` | `14` | Each check asks Mouser for orders placed in this many days (never before the start date) |
| New purchase orders are | `PO_STATUS` | Placed | Placed: ready to receive (and sent on to Xero by the Xero plugin, if it exports placed orders). Pending: left for a person to place. Options: Placed; Pending. |
| Receive into | `PO_DESTINATION` | (blank) | Default stock location for the purchase orders the import makes (optional) |
| Responsible | `PO_RESPONSIBLE` | (blank) | User or group name set as responsible on imported purchase orders. Needed if InvenTree requires a responsible owner on purchase orders. |
| Add Mouser fees | `ADD_FEES` | yes | Add the order's additional fees (tariffs, handling) as an extra line. |

## Carts

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Copy cart prices to the purchase order | `CART_UPDATE_PRICES` | no | On: every line gets Mouser's cart price. Off: only lines with no price. |
